'''xcshort Hunt Down The Rebel Fleet V. 3.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[xcshort]]
* '''Published:''' 12 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed HD xcshort DS 2003 HuntDown.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

I took all of the changes into mind.

You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points- Get both the Executor into hand as well as Flagship Opperations.

Short Range Fighters-Get more TIE's in hand and force retrival as well.

The 3 Commanders-Get TIE's, Systems, and Executor Sites.

Admiral Chiraneau-Add to my Force drains.

Question- If I don't put the Flagship Executor into play until i can play and have Flagship Opperations, how easy would it be for the opponent to actually get rid of?

Random Question-how do you comment on others' decks?
